title: plastic pitchers
text: plastic pitchers. Bought these for our outdoor affairs... they are a nice type of plastic, not brittle - fairly good weight.  I used them for ice water... worked well. Holds about 2 quarts without ice...(?) just an guesstimate.  Again, they worked just as I hoped. I chose the "clear" and they are clear - not cloudy.  I did hand wash them.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid Commercial Bouncer Pitcher, 72 Ounce, Clear, FG333900CLR
features: Durable polycarbonate pitchers resist chipping and breaking
Lighter weight and less costly than glass
description: The Rubbermaid Commercial Bouncer Pitcher is constructed from durable polycarbonate to resist breaking and chipping. Designed to serve cold beverages without the worry of shattering. This plastic pitcher is lighter than a glass water pitcher, meaning less fatigue for staff. This pitcher also features a drip-proof spout to prevent leaking and dripping while serving.
